premises.text: Plant-parasitic nematodes cause large annual crop losses and are hard to control
premises.evidence_span: farmers lose roughly 12% of their crops every year to plant parasitic nematodes

premises.text: Consumers and regulations drive demand for safe, eco-friendly pest-control alternatives
premises.evidence_span: consumers are demanding safe and eco-friendly pest control used on their foods

premises.text: Pheromone-controlled nematode behaviors such as dispersal can be used to control nematodes
premises.evidence_span: This gives us the power to control nematodes. One such behavior is dispersal

premises.text: Ferrocote seed treatment protects young roots by telling plant-parasitic nematodes to find something else to eat
premises.evidence_span: Ferrocote is a seed treatment that is applied to seeds before they are planted, and it protects the young and vulnerable roots from attack by plant parasitic nematodes

premises.text: Nemastim makes beneficial insect-infecting nematodes up to 200% more effective as biocontrols
premises.evidence_span: Nemastim makes beneficial nematodes up to 200% more effective

domains.name: Nematode crop loss and eco-friendly demand

value.text: Eco-friendly nematode control so farmers can grow more food
value.evidence_span: Our eco-friendly products control nematodes, so farmers can grow more food
